issues.detail: Compound 4 was synthesized but did not match natural isatindigotindoline B. The revised Scheme 4 structure has not been synthesized in this paper and is not a reaction product.

Main text claims absolute configuration confirmation for 22, while SI reports centrosymmetric P21/n for 22 and P21/c for 6. Encode relative configurations with enhanced AND groups; no enantiopure absolute identity asserted.

Bracketed source-drawn imines and amino bromide are retained only as unisolated internal stages. Proposed oxidation radicals I-IV, 17-star, unfavourable 17-prime and retrosynthetic structures are not isolated syntheses.
SI header/product calls the alcohol S7; both scheme and oxidation procedure use S2. One molecular record preserves both labels.
issues.subject: S7

issues.detail: SI text calls 12 an aldehyde; its drawing and systematic heading describe a methyl cinnamate ester. Graph follows the drawing.
SI 7 mmol BF3 etherate is paired with 281 mg; compound 12 is given as 4.13 g and 3.15 mmol in the same one-pot procedure. These inconsistent quantities are not normalized into stoichiometry.
issues.subject: E08/E10

issues.detail: Crystal formula C24H28N2O8 exceeds neutral graph/HRMS C24H26N2O7 by H2O. Possible hydrate is recorded, not incorporated into the covalent graph or asserted without CIF.
The preparation of known N-tosyl acid 13-prime and acquisition/preparation of acetal 18 precede the article-drawn route boundary; commercial-start completeness is not asserted.
issues.subject: 13-prime/18
